typography.notes: Use Nunito for all headings with tracking-tight. Use Work Sans for body and UI elements. Ensure typography scales are generous but not overly massive (e.g., text-3xl for main page titles).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border (#E1DED8). No glassmorphism here, as this is a habit tracker where data clarity is needed.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm) for interactive cards on hover.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for buttons, rounded-md for checkboxes.

components.name: Navigation (Sidebar & Top Nav)
components.description: Sidebar on desktop, Top nav on mobile. Minimalist, with exact labels: 'My habits', 'Community', and 'Sign out'. Active state uses the primary color background with white text or primary text with secondary background.

components.name: HabitCard
components.description: Horizontal card displaying habit name, 'When I do it', privacy status tag ('Shared' or 'Private'), 'Days done:' count, 'Current streak:' count. Clicking the name routes to detail page.

components.name: AddHabitForm
components.description: Form containing 'Habit name' (input), 'When I do it' (textarea), 'Share with the community' (checkbox, unticked by default), and 'Add habit' (button).

components.name: SevenDayCheckboxes
components.description: A horizontal list under 'Last 7 days' showing 7 checkboxes labelled with dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Owner only can change.

components.name: CommunityHabitCard
components.description: Card showing habit name, owner display name, 'When I do it' text, 'Days done: N'. Click name to open habit detail.

components.name: CommentFeed
components.description: A list of comments with commenter names visible. Includes a 'Comment' input field and a 'Post comment' button.

components.name: AuthForms
components.description: Sign up page requires: 'Display name', 'Email', 'Password', 'Sign up' button. Sign in page requires: 'Email', 'Password', 'Sign in' button. Clean, generous padding.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[240px_1fr]. Sidebar on left (hidden on mobile), top nav on mobile. Main content area should be centered with max-width (max-w-5xl) and padding (p-6 md:p-12).
layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Use gap-6 for lists. Avoid tight packing.

motion.hover: Hover on clickable cards/buttons shifts -translate-y-0.5 with subtle shadow increase.
motion.interactions: Checkbox toggle uses subtle scale animation. Transitions should target specific properties (e.g. transition-colors).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary color (#5C7C5A) meets 4.5:1 against white background.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 for all interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid on all forms, buttons, checkboxes, and links (e.g., data-testid='sign-in-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 'Sign in' / 'Sign up' flow with exact labels. Once authenticated, open 'My habits'.
Every page must have links to 'My habits' and 'Community' plus 'Sign out' button; also sidebar buttons to those pages.
Implement 'My habits' view showing only own habits. Include the add form with 'Habit name', 'When I do it' (textarea), 'Share with the community' (unticked by default), 'Add habit' button.
List of habits must show 'Shared' or 'Private'. Clicking name opens its page.
Habit page must show name, 'When I do it' text, list 'Last 7 days' with 7 checkboxes labelled with date YYYY-MM-DD (owner only can change), 'Days done:' count, and 'Current streak:' count.
Community page shows only shared habits with name, owner display name, 'When I do it' text, 'Days done: N'. Click name opens habit.
Inside habit detail (for community), signed-in members can write 'Comment' and press 'Post comment'; commenter names must be visible.
Store comments and habit completions effectively.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align content for readability.
Avoid applying 'transition: all', target specific properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover and focus states explicitly set.
Create depth through layered design elements (1px borders + soft shadows).
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons.
No AI emoji icons. Use clean SVG icons.
Use sonner for toast notifications for success/error states.
